Hi Olga,

Thanks for the quick intro. CycloneAI would like to get an initial discovery on the calendar to align ramp timing and scope before we commit to a POC. Key folks we want on the call: myself (product champion), Liam O'Connor (eng lead), procurement for contracting questions, and our security contact to confirm data flow needs.

Possible windows next week (our timezone ET):
- Tue 2026-11-09: 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00 ET
- Wed 2026-11-10: 14:00–16:00 ET

If you can propose times that include an SE and someone from CS/AM (if needed) that would be ideal. We also prefer a 60-minute slot given multiple stakeholders.

Agenda items: 1) goals & milestones for a POC, 2) technical constraints (data, auth, network), 3) procurement timeline and required docs.

Thanks — happy to be flexible if you propose a couple of concrete slots.

—Amina

1) Tue 2026-11-09 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET
2) Tue 2026-11-09 15:00 PT / 18:00 ET
3) Wed 2026-11-10 11:00 PT / 14:00 ET

Once we pick a slot I'll send a calendar invite and include procurement + security on the invite so they have the SOW/contract docs ahead of time.
